description: Uncommented CSS snippets for the SPOKES theme library. generate-theme-library.py emits theme-library.css; the Bespoke wizard injects the same snippets into template markup for preview (FID-3).
fileHeader:
/* ==========================================================================
   SPOKES Two-Layer Theme System — CSS Library
   ==========================================================================

   This file is GENERATED from theme-options.json by
   scripts/generate-theme-library.py. Edit the JSON, then regenerate.
   Agents still copy relevant sections into <style id="theme-override">.

   SCOPE prefix mechanism:
     When building a theme-override block, agents replace the literal text
     SCOPE with [data-chapter="N"] to target chapter-level styles.
     Example:  SCOPE .card  -->  [data-chapter="3"] .card

   DIVIDER_SCOPE prefix mechanism:
     Agents replace the literal text DIVIDER_SCOPE with
     .slide-section[data-chapter="N"] to target section dividers.
     Example:  DIVIDER_SCOPE .divider-title  -->  .slide-section[data-chapter="2"] .divider-title

   Brand palette variables (defined in template.html :root):
     --primary   #007baf
     --accent    #37b550
     --dark      #004071
     --light     #FFFFFF
     --muted     #EDF3F7
     --gray      #60636b
     --gold      #d3b257
     --royal     #00133f
     --mauve     #a7253f
     --offwhite  #d1d3d4
     --muted-gold #ad8806

   No other colors are permitted.
   ========================================================================== */

sections.title: BACKGROUND TEXTURES
sections.intro:
Six texture options. Each is wrapped in comments. Agents uncomment the
one they need and place it inside a <style id="theme-override"> block.
The "plain" texture uses var(--light) which is already the default, so
no override is needed — it is listed here only for completeness.

options.label: Plain
Dot Grid
Diagonal
Crosshatch
Soft Gradient
Dark Royal

sections.title: DARK THEME INVERSION
sections.intro:
Applied when backgroundTexture is dark-royal. Agents uncomment the
blocks below into style#theme-override and add class="theme-dark" to .main.

options.css:
.theme-dark .slide h2,
.theme-dark .slide h3,
.theme-dark .slide p,
.theme-dark .card h4,
.theme-dark .card p,
.theme-dark .smart-content h4,
.theme-dark .smart-content p,
.theme-dark .area-card ul li,
.theme-dark .takeaway-item p,
.theme-dark .activity-box p,
.theme-dark .matrix-label,
.theme-dark .matrix-desc,
.theme-dark ul.content-list li {
  color: var(--light);
}

sections.title: COLOR LEADS
sections.intro:
Nine color-lead options. Agents uncomment the assigned lead into
style#theme-override. Do not invent new lead hexes (D6).

options.label: Blue
Mauve
Gold
Green
Royal
Dual Mauve–Blue
Dual Gold–Green
Dual Mauve–Gold
Dual Blue–Green

sections.title: SIDEBAR COLORS
sections.intro:
Two sidebar background options. Agents uncomment the desired option.
The "dark" sidebar is the default, so no override is needed — it is
listed here for completeness.

options.label: Dark
options.css: .sidebar { background: var(--dark); }

options.label: Royal

agent builds a theme-override, replace SCOPE with [data-chapter="N"].
Stable IDs: cards.{slug} — see bespoke-library-catalog.json.

sections.intro:
Divider options. Replace DIVIDER_SCOPE with
.slide-section[data-chapter="N"]. Stable IDs: dividers.{slug}.

sections.intro:
Title-slide design options. Each COMMENTED block targets .slide-title.
Stable IDs: titleSlides.{slug}.

options.label: Centered Gradient
notes: No overrides needed — this is the template default.

options.label: Split Hero
Full Bleed

Diagonal Split
Framed Center
Top Banner

options.css:
.slide-title { background: var(--royal); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.slide-title::before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 400px; height: 400px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,123,175,0.25) 0%, transparent 70%); top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }

options.label: Vertical Strip
Corner Accent
Horizon Line
options.css:
.slide-title { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--royal) 0%, var(--dark) 50%, var(--dark) 50%, var(--primary) 100%); flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.slide-title .divider { width: 200px; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gold), transparent); margin: 1rem auto; }

options.label: Quiet Center
